components.name: generic-extraction
components.scope: Direct HTTP media and uncompressed UTF-8/ASCII HTML5 pages with audio/video elements, typed progressive HTTP sources, explicit zero-based source-ID selection per entry, and fully extracted playlists for multiple elements; optional positive source width/height/res attributes and bounded resolution-based default/best/worst ranking; no embedded players, full upstream ranking, nested/site playlists or manifests

components.name: extractor-contract
components.scope: Small typed video info and progressive VideoFormat subset, ExtractResult video/PlaylistInfo variants for fully extracted HTML5 entries, literal-ID and bounded resolution-based default/best/worst selection, ordered extractor registry, shared direct response inspection, opt-in whole-extraction retries with bounded Retry-After delay-seconds/preferred HTTP-date; no nested playlists or unresolved URL results

components.name: http-downloader
components.scope: Streaming whole-file transfers, page referrers for HTML5 media, no-clobber publication, bounded download retries for selected transient HTTP statuses and connection/body failures, in-invocation range resume guarded by strong ETags, known lengths and response validation; shared transient HTTP classification/backoff with extraction; bounded Retry-After delay-seconds/preferred HTTP-date shared with extraction; no persistent resume, Last-Modified validators or obsolete HTTP-date Retry-After formats

components.name: orchestration-and-output
components.scope: Multiple URLs, simulate, per-video NDJSON, sequential HTML5 playlist entry downloads with failure continuation, basic output templates, literal HTML5 source-ID or bounded resolution-based default/best/worst selection applied independently to each entry, bounded --retries download option with guarded range recovery and independent opt-in --extractor-retries whole-extraction budget with bounded Retry-After delay-seconds/preferred HTTP-date; no general option parity
